messages:
ashley: Customer (FinServX) — large embed + generate calls — started seeing 502 then 504s from hosted inference around 03:00Z. They also reported a billing spike (double token counts) for the same window. Sample request id: req_8f4b2c. Repro snippet attached.

mike_oncall: ack — pinging infra. Do we have any recent config/rotation events at 03:00Z? any auth key rotations or edge deploys?

jordan_platform: checking deploys now — no control-plane deploys at 03:00Z. There was a scheduled KMS key rotation for a partner account at 02:58Z but it was scoped to Dedicated. Not expected to affect hosted.

ashley: customer sent this minimal repro curl (they used our python SDK, but reproduced with curl):

```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input": ["long text ... repeated to ~120k chars"], "model": "open-embed-64k"}'
```

ashley: they see a 502 with body "upstream reset" then a follow-up 504 on retry. SDK shows 2 retries -> double token billing. Logs show streaming connection closed mid-response.

mike_oncall: grabbing proxies/edge logs for req_8f4b2c. early look: several connections from edge->gateway had TCP RSTs around 03:00:12Z. Also seeing increased active connections for embed route (p95 concurrency spike). Possible connection exhaustion + auth handshake failures.

sre-bot: alert triggered: edge.conn.reset.rate exceeding threshold in region-usw2 at 2026-03-15T03:00:10Z (rule edge-conn-reset-v2).

jordan_platform: dug into gateway: there are intermittent auth error bursts (401) for the same customer token followed immediately by 502 upstreams. Hypothesis: token refresh race on client side causing concurrent ephemeral connections with partially invalid tokens -> edge rejects some, gateway tries fallback route producing reset. Also batching/kv-cache pressure for long sequence lengths.

ashley: customer says their SDK does an immediate token refresh when they see a 401 and then retries requests without exponential backoff. That matches double billing pattern. They run many concurrent embedding calls (hundreds). We should surface guidance to them ASAP.

mike_oncall: temporary mitigations applied at 03:10Z: 1) increased edge keepalive timeout to reduce conn churn, 2) bumped embed-route connection pool size on gateway to smooth handoffs, 3) enabled 5s client-side retry-window for auth failures (server-side gate) to discourage immediate retry storms.

jordan_platform: also pushed a gating rule to drop rapid auth refreshes for the same token id for 2s to prevent fanout. Need postmortem if this recurs. I'm opening ENG ticket ENG-9921.

ashley: customer update: told FinServX that we saw connection resets at edge + auth-refresh fanout; asked them to upgrade SDK to use exponential backoff for 401s. Provided a temporary suggestion: set SDK MAX_CONCURRENT=40 and enable jittered backoff.

ashley: sample SDK guidance I sent:

```
# pseudo
on_401: sleep(random.uniform(0.5,1.5))
retry with backoff *and* decrement concurrent semaphore
```

mike_oncall: monitoring — since mitigations at 03:10Z we see client retries drop ~60% and 502/504 rate for the embed route decreased to baseline by 03:22Z. Billing team flagged ~12 customers with duplicate token increments; finance will reconcile. Marking customer-facing incident as "mitigated" but still investigating root cause chain.

ashley: next steps: 1) engineering to trace auth-refresh -> edge reset chain (ENG-9921), 2) docs update for SDK retry/backoff patterns, 3) billing reconciliation with finance & customer refund offer if necessary. I'll draft comms to FinServX with timeline and recommended SDK patch.

mike_oncall: adding note — if we see recurrence, immediate action: throttle token refresh endpoints and route failover to a cold model variant to reduce KV cache pressure.

ashley: thanks team. FinServX wants ETA for permanent fix — I'll tell them we'll follow up in 48h with root-cause analysis and next steps.

jordan_platform: noted. saving logs and sample traces under ENG-9921. Will run replay on a staging harness to attempt deterministic repro.

ashley: closing thread for now; will reopen if FinServX reports more issues. :white_check_mark:
